title: Work IQ: human in the loop for agents and agent flows
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned human-approval capability from existing Work IQ and Copilot Studio controls. The roadmap facts and consumption billing are supported, and the conflicting published write-operation defaults are reported rather than silently resolved. The maker path could include the initial agent selection.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to let Work IQ agents and agent flows pause for human input or approval before continuing.
claims.quote: Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

Microsoft has not stated the arrival default for this human-in-the-loop capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default; "Work IQ" "human-in-the-loop". Read roadmap, Work IQ API overview and add-work-iq; none states this capability's default.

claims.claim: The specific planned pause-and-approval capability has no published detail beyond its roadmap description.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human-in-the-loop"; "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default. Opened Work IQ API overview, add-work-iq, policy-governance-mcp and add-tools-custom-agent; results describe background or other approval mechanisms.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; What's changing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented maker configuration or a tenant human-in-the-loop policy on either surface for this Work IQ capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human" "policy" approval administrator; "Work IQ MCP" policy Microsoft Graph API settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Work IQ" "policy". Opened policy-governance-mcp and Work IQ API overview; no human-approval policy documented.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published where approvers respond for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human-in-the-loop"; "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default. Opened Work IQ API overview and add-work-iq; neither describes an approver response surface for this feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published what data this capability displays in approval requests.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human-in-the-loop"; "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default. Opened Work IQ API overview and add-work-iq; neither describes the planned approval request contents.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published how this capability verifies approver identity.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default; "Work IQ" "human" "policy" approval administrator. Opened Work IQ API overview and policy-governance-mcp; user authentication is described, but approver verification is not.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published how approver identity is recorded for this capability.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default; "Work IQ" "human" "policy" approval administrator. Read Work IQ API overview and Work IQ overview governance excerpts; general tool logging does not specify approval identity records.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described this capability's approval timeouts.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" approval pause timeout billing credits; "Work IQ" "human input" approval identity timeout default. Opened Work IQ API overview and add-work-iq; timeout results concern other products, not this capability.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes, cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Work IQ uses consumption billing with Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing. ... Work IQ in Copilot Studio is powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, which uses Copilot Credits for usage-based billing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Any additional charge specific to pauses or approvals has not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" approval pause timeout billing credits. Opened add-work-iq, Work IQ API overview and Plan licensing and cost; these document Copilot Credits consumption but no separate pause or approval charge.

claims.claim: Tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. ... In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. ... On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the Work IQ MCP tenant policy switch is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ MCP" policy Microsoft Graph API settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "Work IQ" "policy". Opened policy-governance-mcp and Work IQ API overview; no executable policy-management endpoint or command found.

claims.claim: The MCP policy article says mutation operations such as sending email are not allowed by default.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.

claims.claim: The Work IQ in Copilot Studio page says write operations are on by default.
claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.

claims.claim: The per-tool confirmation setting is at Copilot Studio > Tools > tool > Details > Additional details > Ask the end user before running.
claims.quote: Go to the Tools page for your agent, and select the tool from the list of tools. ... Details ... Additional details ... Ask the end user before running
claims.fix: Include the initial agent selection: 'Agents > agent > Tools > tool > Details > Additional details > Ask the end user before running', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/add-tools-custom-agent.

claims.claim: Copilot Studio separately documents maker-configured, per-tool end-user confirmation for agents using the standard harness.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness. ... Ask the end user before running: In the end user chat experience, ask the agent for confirmation before running the tool.

claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the per-tool confirmation setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Ask the end user before running" Dataverse API policy; site:learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform "confirmation" "botcomponent". Opened add-tools-custom-agent; searched botcomponent reference for confirmation/approval; no setting mapping.

claims.claim: No central policy requiring the Copilot Studio per-tool confirmation setting was found as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio tool confirmation require approval centrally admin policy "Ask the end user"; "Ask the end user before running" Dataverse API policy. Opened add-tools-custom-agent; read Configure data policies for agents excerpt; no central confirmation mandate.

claims.where: writer evidence: Work IQ consumption billing
claims.claim: The cited Work IQ in Copilot Studio page says a separate spending policy is not required.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing. A separate spending policy isn't required for Work IQ.

claims.claim: The documented standard-harness per-tool confirmation setting defaults to No.
claims.quote: Ask the end user before running: In the end user chat experience, ask the agent for confirmation before running the tool. This option is set to No by default.
